name: Jay & Pamela
description: Follows a couple — both 3 feet and four inches tall — who share the same rare brittle bone disorder.

videos.title: Bones and Brides
videos.overview: Jay and Pamela may have bitten off more than they can chew. They've decided they want to prioritize their health, plan a wedding and move out of their parent's basement apartment in the next 3 months.

videos.title: Breakthroughs & Breakdowns
videos.overview: Pamela has been living in the same house with Jay's parents for the last 5 years but she and his dad have never bonded.

videos.title: Love & Limitations
videos.overview: Jay and Pamela finally make a move toward finding a new apartment.

videos.title: Bonding & Baggage
videos.overview: Pamela's brother says he's coming to the wedding but Jay is skeptical and worries about Pamela getting her hopes up.

videos.title: Husband & Wife
videos.overview: The day they once thought was impossible has finally arrived. Jay and Pamela are getting married, but the question of who will take Pamela down the aisle remains up in the air.

videos.title: Can You Work it, Can You Twerk it?
videos.overview: Jay and Pamela brave New York City to make their runway debut during fashion week. They also want to take in all that NYC has to offer—but sightseeing has its challenges. Raphael and Rene are overwhelmed helping Jay and Pamela shop for a new bed.

videos.title: Risk it For a Biscuit
videos.overview: With Jay turning 30, Pamela plans to celebrate this milestone birthday by giving him the party he always dreamt of as a child. And she has some surprises for him including one that makes him blush!

videos.title: Were We Waiting for a Funeral?
videos.overview: Pamela braces for family drama when she and Jay head to Kansas City for her grandmother's funeral. Rene and Raphael are caught completely off guard when Jay and Pamela reveal plans for the future. A visit to a fertility clinic has Pamela on edge.

videos.title: Surprise, You're a Daddy!⁩
videos.overview: Raphael and Rene question Jay and Pamela's choice to have a baby, and concerns about the future cause Pamela to wrestle with her difficult childhood.

videos.title: I'll Be Santa, You'll Be Vixen
videos.overview: Now happily married and living on their own, Jay and Pamela are living life to the fullest. When the topic of expanding their family comes up, they have to seriously examine their relationship. Having a baby for Jay and Pamela is the ultimate decision.
